about_the_game:
This is the story of Remus, an honoured member of Wallachia's Order. Mysterious disappearances and a new trail of his lost brother, Romulus, sent him to the lands of Kronstadt.

Unravel dark secrets rooted in Romanian mythology and fight creatures from traditional folklore: the Moroi, Strigoi, Capcauns, Iele, and other nightmares that defy nature itself. Explore ancient dacian lands, villages and catacombs in your quests to complete the Order's mission. Engage in gritty, first-person combat with weighty swordplay, precise crossbow shots, and powerful flintlock blasts. Instantly switch between melee and ranged weapons to survive the monstrous spawn of Dracula that lurk behind every shadow. Be careful! The sky has 3 pairs of eyes.

Features:

  • First-person combat featuring swords, crossbows, and flintlocks

  • Enemies inspired by Romanian folklore, including Strigoi, Moroi, and other mythic beasts

  • Exploration, puzzle-solving, and story-driven progression

  • A dark mystery tied to your family, Dracula's remnants, and the fate of Kronstadt

  • Atmospheric medieval environments

content_descriptors.notes: Players will experience violent combat in a dark and immersive fantasy environment. Swordplay, Archery, fire arms and more.
